<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="62004009" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/1-john/4/#v62004009" target="_blank">1 John 4:9</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>Jehovah, dear Father,</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">There seemed no hope for us.</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">The ransom has given</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">Hope to ev’ryone!</p>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sp">We give our lives to you,</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sz">Our best in all we do.</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sp">And we’ll tell others too,</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sz">That your will might be done.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sp">You gave your precious Son,</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sz">And now we sing as one,</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sp">A song we’ll sing forever,</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sz">for giving us your precious Son.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sl"><span id="page31" class="pageNum refID" aria-hidden="true" data-no="31" data-before-text="31"> </span><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>Your kindness, your mercy,</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sz">They draw us close to you.</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sp">Your great name, your friendship,</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sz">These we’ve come to love.</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sp">But something more than this</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sz">Is your most precious gift.</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sp">He died that we might live.</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sz">You sent him from above.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sp">You gave your precious Son,</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sz">And now we sing as one,</p>
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 sp">A song we’ll sing forever,</p>
<p id="p29" data-pid="29" class="p29 sz">for giving us your precious Son.</p>
</div>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p30" data-pid="30" class="p30 se">(ENDING)</p>
<p id="p31" data-pid="31" class="p31 sp">Jehovah, dear Father, we pray in gratitude.</p>
<p id="p32" data-pid="32" class="p32 sz">We offer our thanks for giving us your precious Son.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p33" data-pid="33" class="p33 se">(See also <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="43003016" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/john/3/#v43003016" target="_blank">John 3:16;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="43015013" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/john/15/#v43015013" target="_blank"> 15:13</a>.)</p>
</div>
